verdict.rationale: RUN Powered by ADP is a payroll/HR SaaS rather than an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence shows API Central (REST APIs with OAuth 2.0, templates, code samples) and AI features such as a virtual assistant, but nothing about an MCP server. API access is a developer building block, not the capability itself, so it earns no credit.
